facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet on a dark background, with a wide top scene labeled 'HERO' and smaller labeled breakdown panels below.

In the top HERO panel, a person stands centered on a wet, reflective elevated walkway or rooftop at night; metal railings run along both sides, dark buildings and blurred lights are behind, and rain streaks are visible.

The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot at the back, a visible scar through one eyebrow, an athletic build, and wears an all-black tactical outfit: a high-collared jacket with strap and buckle details, dark shirt, cargo trousers, and lace-up combat boots.
Below the hero image, three full-body panels show the same person from the front, side, and back, labeled 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', and 'BACK'.
In the FRONT panel the person stands facing the camera with arms at their sides; in SIDE PROFILE they face image-left; in BACK they face away.
Four bottom detail panels labeled 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS' show a close-up face, the jacket collar with a buckled strap, bare hands, and black lace-up boots.

The hero scene uses low-key cinematic lighting with cool blue-gray night ambience, warm amber streetlights, wet reflections, and visible rain; the lower studio panels use soft directional light against a dark charcoal backdrop.
Visible labels read 'HERO', 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', 'BACK', 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.

card.summary: A multi-panel character reference sheet for a person in an all-black tactical outfit, featuring a rainy nighttime hero shot, front/side/back turnaround views, and close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.

subjects.descriptor: Adult person with short dark undercut hair and a small topknot, wearing a black tactical jacket, shirt, cargo trousers, and combat boots; shown consistently across multiple reference panels.

card.environment: Top scene: rainy nighttime urban rooftop or elevated walkway with metal railings, wet reflective pavement, dark building facades, and blurred lights. Lower panels: plain dark studio backdrop.

card.style: Realistic cinematic character reference sheet with gritty tactical styling.
card.characterisation: Gritty, tactical cinematic character design presented as a live-action-style photo reference sheet.

limitations: This is a single still reference sheet; it does not establish motion, camera movement, sound, music, voice, or dialogue.
The hero background is dark and out of focus, so distant architectural details and the exact location are unclear.
The turnaround and detail panels do not provide a continuous 360-degree capture; some sides and garment details remain unseen.
